paite: Diktatna thu dai dide in maw na gen taktak uh! Mihing tate aw, diktak in maw vai na hawm uh!
heading: David La / Pathian In Migilou Agawtna Dia Thumna
english: For the Chief Musician. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A poem by David. Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?

paite: Ahi, na lungtang uah thil thulim lou na hih nak ua; leitung ah na khut ua thil ngongtatna na bukkhia uhi.
english: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands on the earth.

paite: Migilou-saloute anu uh gilsung a kipan in Pathian a pan khen in a-om ua; apiantak un zuauthu gen in avakmang zel uhi.
english: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.

paite: Agu uh gulgu bang ahi a; thangtom nangong abil hum bang ahi uhi.
english: Their poison is like the poison of a snake, like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,

paite: Huai in gul aitawi aw angaikhe kei a, bangchibang a siam in bum mah le uh.
english: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.

paite: Pathian aw, akam uah hate tansak inla; TOUPA aw, humpinelkai hatsanlaite ha lian pipite tongkhia in.
english: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.

paite: Amau tui hattak a luang bang in tuimang uhenla; athalte a angim in, sattan bang in om zel hen.
english: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.

paite: Dokdawn, tui a mang maimah zel bang hileh; ahun lou a numei nau neih, nisa mel mu lou bang hi hen aw.
english: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.

paite: Na belte un ling satna atheih ma un leng ama'n pingpei in alamang ding; ahing lai leh akuang lai leng.
english: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.

paite: Midiktat in phulakna amuh in akipak ding a, migilou-salou sisan ah akhe asil ding hi.
english: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked,

paite: Huchi in mite'n, "Midiktat a ding in kipahman a-om taktak a, lei ah vaihawmpa Pathian a-om taktak hi," achi ding uhi.
english: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
